mathematical_checks: A three-triangle chain has a unique middle triangle, two distinct canceled tips, and a five-point support inducing an isolated point plus 2K2, P4, or C4.

For a fixed support, its isolated point is determined and each perfect matching of the other four points determines the two canceled tips by the unique-common-neighbor rule. There are at most two such matchings.
Two chains with the same support use at most nine vertices. The complete cap-valid catalogue on orders seven through nine therefore contains every possible collision union.

For a double word, the two matchings reconstruct four distinct canceled tips. Their six triangles produce the eighteen edges of a unique induced nine-vertex rook grid; no extra edge is allowed by the visible caps.
Conversely each induced rook grid gives nine double words. A double support reconstructs the whole grid uniquely, so two different grids cannot account for the same double word.
There are 231*3*6^2=24948 chains in any SRG(99,14,1,2), hence 24948-9*g distinct constructed weight-five dual-code words.
Using the separately established bound g<=120 yields at least 23868 weight-five dual words.
MacWilliams with lower bound L_j gives sum_w (L_j-K_j(w))*A_w <= binom(99,j)-L_j. Nonnegative exact dual multipliers and all seven columns certify the size upper bound.
The code size is a power of two. A size upper bound strictly below 4096 implies dimension at most eleven and binary point-triangle incidence rank at least eighty-eight.
source_checks: The collision builder enumerates unordered endpoint pairs for each middle triangle once, checks reconstructed literal edges, and binds the complete catalogue hash.

The LP builder binds the collision source and census hashes, retains all ninety-nine Krawtchouk inequalities and all seven allowed weight variables, and uses numerical output only to propose rational supports.
The exact acceptance helper checks every dual sign and column; if a primal is accepted it checks all ninety-nine constraints and all seven nonnegative bounds.
The replay path calls no optimizer and binds source, preparation, model, and result hashes.
independent_arithmetic_method: Fresh V8 BigInt rational arithmetic using the finite binomial-sum definition of every Krawtchouk value; no import of subject code.
limits: The catalogue census was source-reviewed and its saved metadata/hash were checked; the 6435-host enumeration was not repeated.
The graph existence problem is not resolved. A trivial binary kernel remains compatible with the bound.
The upper bound g<=120 is a previously proved input, not reproved here.
